SELECT
  o.id AS id,                                        -- keep as PK (not searchable)
  ANY_VALUE(CAST(o.id AS CHAR(36)))        AS id_text,        -- searchable string
  ANY_VALUE(o.c_title)                     AS product_title,
  ANY_VALUE(CAST(o.c_sector AS CHAR(36)))  AS sector_id_text, -- searchable string
  ANY_VALUE(os.c_title)                    AS sector_name,
  ANY_VALUE(o.c_standard_quantity)         AS product_standard_qty,
  ANY_VALUE(o.c_hscode)                    AS product_hscode,
  ANY_VALUE(
    JSON_ARRAY(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'product_description',        o.c_title,
        'product_code',               o.c_product_code,
        'product_hscode',             o.c_hscode,
        'product_uom',                o.c_uom,
        'product_standard_quantity',  o.c_standard_quantity,
        'raw_material_type',          COALESCE(rmt.types_json, JSON_ARRAY())
      )
    )
  ) AS add_products
FROM app_fd_eth_ioc_products o
JOIN app_fd_eth_ioc_sector os ON os.id = o.c_sector
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    i.c_product,
    JSON_ARRAYAGG(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'raw_material_type_description',  i.c_title,
        'raw_material_type_code',         i.c_raw_material_type_code,
        'quantity',                       i.c_quantity,
        'uom',                            i.c_uom,
        'waste_percentage',               i.c_waste_percentage,
        'input_output_coefficient',       i.c_input_output_coefficient,
        'raw_material_input',             COALESCE(rii.items_json, JSON_ARRAY())
      )
    ) AS types_json
  FROM app_fd_eth_ioc_raw_mat_type i
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      ii.c_raw_material_type,
      JSON_ARRAYAGG(
        JSON_OBJECT(
          'input_description',  ii.c_title,
          'input_code',         ii.c_input_code,
          'hscode',             ii.c_hscode
        )
      ) AS items_json
    FROM app_fd_eth_ioc_raw_mat_item ii
    GROUP BY ii.c_raw_material_type
  ) rii ON rii.c_raw_material_type = i.id
  GROUP BY i.c_product
) rmt ON rmt.c_product = o.id
GROUP BY o.id
